note: Kevin's 21 Sep original marketed 20.9% IRR / 2.3x / $158 PSF / $188K exit / 7.1% YoC / Feb close. The $210K equity step-up is close to Chip's ~$233K broker-fee estimate and lands right after the RJL engagement letter went out, so the working read is that the intermediary fee is now inside the raise — nothing states that outright. Three sets are therefore live in market at once: 20.3% to the 83 firms reached before 27 Oct, 21.5% to the blast and to CIM, and 20.9% here.
